name: thumbview
description: See every file in your workspace at once as a stable, syntax-highlighted minimap grid. Search them all and jump to any line in one click.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Files are read through VS Code's file system API. Git status markers are unavailable, and only each folder's root .gitignore applies (nested ones do not); files.exclude still applies.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode Thumbview does not run git, so git status markers are hidden and only each folder's root .gitignore applies, read as text (nested ones do not). files.exclude still applies.

enumDescriptions: Standard uniform grid (1 cell per file)
Spanning Grid (tall files span multiple vertical cells)
thumbview.layoutMode.description: Select the layout algorithm mode for displaying codebase thumbnails.

enumDescriptions: If thumbnails are the same shape, they will simply swap positions.
Thumbnails will be shifted down and to the left in column order, reflowing the layout.
thumbview.dragReorderMode.description: Select the drag-and-drop behaviour when manually re-arranging thumbnails.

thumbview.autoIgnoreThreshold.description: Automatically ignore subdirectories containing more than this number of files (set to 0 to disable).

thumbview.renderMediaThumbnails.description: Whether image and PDF thumbnails are rendered inside Thumbview tiles.

thumbview.compressionPercentage.description: Compression threshold for spanning grid mode. When code shrinks to this percentage of its height in a cell, the tile expands one cell taller (0% disables expansion, recommended: 1% to 20%, default: 5%).

thumbview.minCellWidth.description: Minimum tile width in pixels before grouping workspace files into subfolder cards.

thumbview.minCellHeight.description: Minimum tile height in pixels before grouping workspace files into subfolder cards.

thumbview.fullscreenOnOpen.description: Open Thumbview fullscreen (Zen mode, other editor groups hidden). The first time you open Thumbview in a session it adjusts a few zenMode.* settings (no OS fullscreen, no centered layout, no tabs) and restores your values when VS Code closes. Disable to open Thumbview as a normal editor tab and leave Zen settings untouched.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Thumbview is a full-workspace visual minimap grid.

[Open Thumbview](command:thumbview.open)

[Configure Hotkey](command:thumbview.configureHotkey)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Thumbview
walkthroughs.description: See your whole workspace at once, and learn the few keys that make Thumbview fast.

steps.title: Open Thumbview
steps.description:
Press F4 to see every file as a tile that keeps its place. F4 or Esc takes you back.
[Open Thumbview](command:thumbview.open)

steps.title: Search every file by typing
steps.description: With Thumbview open, just start typing. Matches light up across every tile.

steps.title: Read code without opening it
steps.description: Hold Left Ctrl over a tile to magnify the code under the pointer.

steps.title: Jump to any line
steps.description: Click a line to open the file there, or a folder card to look inside. Everything also works from the keyboard.

steps.title: Hide what you don't need
steps.description: Ignore files and folders from the tile menu or Folders & Ignored. Nothing else moves.
